import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_conjugation_transport {G : Type*} [Group G]
  (hG : ∀ (H : Subgroup G), H.Normal) (a b : G) :
  ∃ (j : ℤ), b * a = a ^ j * b ∧
    ∀ (N n : ℕ), n ≤ N → ∃ k : ℤ, b ^ n * a = a ^ k * b ^ n := by
  have hmem : a ∈ Subgroup.zpowers a := Subgroup.mem_zpowers a
  have hnorm := hG (Subgroup.zpowers a)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp (hnorm.conj_mem a hmem b)
  refine ⟨j, by rw [hj]; group, fun N n _ => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp (hnorm.conj_mem a hmem (b ^ n))
  exact ⟨k, by rw [hk]; group⟩
